definition_zh: 相对于基频为较高整数倍频率的谐波成分。
usage_overview: 在列车作用下的桥梁动力分析中，用于考察主导频率的较高整数倍频率成分对响应的影响；这些成分可能在一定车速条件下激发桥梁共振。

P093.title: Influence of dominant frequencies and their higher harmonics on the dynamic responses of railway bridge subjected to high-speed trains
P093.authors: NK Kedia, C Ngamkhanong, Y Singh, L Xu
P093.label: Kedia等（2025）

complete_examples.text: It is observed that the high-stiffness bridges are more significantly influenced by higher harmonics compared to low-stiffness bridges, where the effect of the first or second harmonics is more pronounced, and the higher harmonics have a diminishing effect on the bridge response.

The parametric analysis is conducted on the validated model by varying the flexural rigidity of the bridges within the range of 0.5EI – 2.0 EI, and five different cases for each span length are discussed to understand the effect of dominant frequencies and their higher harmonics on the bridge dy namics.
